Step into the undead survival experience with the Call of Duty Gobblegum Replica Dispenser, a must-have collectible for any Zombies fan. Modeled after the iconic perk machine from the game, this highly detailed piece is crafted from premium die-cast metal to deliver a display-worthy collectible that feels as authentic as it looks. Standing out with its vibrant design and game-accurate detailing, the dispenser features a unique two-stage lenticular hatch that mirrors the mysterious, otherworldly vibe of the Gobblegum machines in-game. More than a display piece, this working machine can be loaded with standard gumballs up to 0.5" in diameter, adding an interactive touch to your collection. Whether you're a longtime Zombies veteran or a new recruit, the Gobblegum Replica Dispenser makes a standout centerpiece for any Call of Duty collection - equal parts nostalgia, functionality, and premium craftsmanship.
